_comment: CPython C-API addresses per TTREngine build, keyed by the arm64 Mach-O UUID (as-linked vmaddrs, image base 0x100000000; driver adds the runtime ASLR slide). TTR auto-patches the engine; when the UUID changes, re-derive with the `re` skill and add a new entry. `verify` holds each function's prologue bytes so the driver aborts on a changed binary. IMPORTANT: this hardened LTO CPython 3.7 deploy build dead-strips PyRun_* AND the bytecode compiler, and exec/eval are code-object-only, so the runnable primitive is `marshal_evalcode` (inject a host-marshalled code object -> marshal.loads -> PyEval_EvalCode with f_globals read off the live frame), NOT exec_builtins. PyModule_GetDict / PyImport_AddModule / PyBytes_FromStringAndSize are all inlined away by whole-program LTO (no standalone), hence the frame-globals read and the PyByteArray bytes-like constructor. See STATUS.md. Driver rework to the marshal_evalcode recipe is still pending.

4C4C44C3-5555-3144-A136-F2D2B4A39415.note: TTREngine May 2024 build. All addresses confirmed via the `re` skill and internally consistent. PENDING only: driver rework from exec_builtins to the marshal_evalcode recipe (STATUS.md), then a live attach smoke test.
